name: emoji
title: Emoji
description: An emoji picker: every emoji in a grid, recently used first, found by name, keyword or :shortcode:. Copy or paste it in your skin tone.
author: pal

settings.label: Skin tone
settings.description: Applied to the emoji that take one (hands, people) when shown, copied and pasted.

settings.label: Paste on Enter
settings.text: Enter pastes the emoji into the app in front; ⌘Enter copies it
settings.description: Off, Enter copies and ⌘Enter pastes. Pasting needs Accessibility on macOS.

settings.label: Your keywords
settings.description: Extra search words per emoji, one line each: a shortcode or the emoji, a colon, then the words (`rocket: ship deploy`, `🎉: party woo`). A line naming no emoji is ignored.

store.tagline: Every emoji in a grid; copy or paste it, or its :shortcode:
features: Every emoji in a grid by category, the ones you used lately first
Search by name, keyword or shortcode: `thumbs`, `celebrate`, `:thumbs_up:`
Add your own keywords: `ship` and `deploy` for the rocket
`enter` copies, `cmd+enter` pastes into the app in front (or the other way round, a setting)
A skin tone setting, applied everywhere it can be
